requirement.description: Missing sample PDF files required by several tests. Tests are failing with FileNotFoundError when trying to read './samples/add_text_annotation.pdf' and './samples/simple_text_string.pdf'.
requirement.contract: Ensure that the sample PDF files referenced in the test suite exist in the correct location relative to the working directory, or modify the test setup to use alternative approaches for accessing test data.

requirement.description: Issue with parsing array containing multiple comments. The test expects parsing of "[/abc %b %c \n 123%d\n]" to return ["/abc", 123], but the parser is not correctly handling comments within arrays.
requirement.contract: Update the parse_obj function to properly handle comments within array structures. Comments should be skipped during parsing without affecting the parsing of subsequent array elements.

requirement.description: Incorrect handling of stream parsing. The test expects parsing of "stream\n xyz \nendstream " to return a STREAM token, but the current implementation seems to be returning an unexpected result.
requirement.contract: Fix the next_token function to properly detect stream markers and correctly identify the boundaries of stream content, including handling various line ending formats.

requirement.description: Incorrect handling of UTF-16BE encoded text strings. The test expects parsing of "(\xfe\xff\x00M\x00a\x00r\x00t\x00i\x00n\x00 \x00D\x00.)" to return "Martin D.", but the current implementation isn't properly decoding the UTF-16BE encoding.
requirement.contract: Update the text_string function to properly decode UTF-16BE encoded strings when the byte order mark (BOM) is present at the beginning of the string.
